name: ab-test-planner
description: Create and check an A/B test plan with sample size and run time. It works only with details you enter, never posts, sends, publishes, or connects to an account or tool, and makes no result promises.
keywords: how long to run an AB test

interface.shortDescription: A/B test plan and sample size
interface.longDescription: For teams planning a conversion experiment. Create a clear test brief, calculate sample size and run time, check the hypothesis, metrics, tracking, and stop rule, then export the plan. It works only with details you enter, never posts, sends, publishes, or connects to an account or tool, and makes no result promises.
defaultPrompt: Help me plan an A/B test.
Calculate sample size for my conversion test.

positive.prompt: Help me plan an A/B test.

positive.expected_behavior: Calculates sample size and validates the plan.

positive.prompt: Export my approved A/B test plan.

negative.expected_behavior: Explains that it does not connect to accounts.

negative.prompt: Publish this test on my website.
Guarantee this test will improve conversions.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that it cannot guarantee results.
